corrections.text: The article states that OpenCode "said it would explore reimbursement for affected users." BleepingComputer reports only that OpenCode's message to impacted users "mentions the possibility of reimbursement"; it does not report a commitment to explore it.

The "What We Don't Know" section, citing The Hacker News, says OpenCode has not said when the unauthorized access began. BleepingComputer reports that OpenCode's email to impacted users gives the earliest possible exposure of the keys as October 17, 2026, 00:30 UTC, and says no data appears to have been exposed.
